While this role is aligned to a defined group of products, prioritization is driven by company-level goals and key performance metrics, not equal attention across every surface.

You’ll work closely with cross-functional partners to continuously assess where Product Marketing efforts will have the greatest impact and dynamically allocate time and resources accordingly — meaning some products or initiatives may require deeper focus at different points in time.

The role covers about Persona Persona is the configurable identity platform built for businesses in a digital-first world; verifying individuals and organizations is harder — but more important — than ever, with AI enabling fraudsters to launch sophisticated accounts at scale and regulations evolving rapidly. We’re growing rapidly and looking for exceptional people to join us!
responsibilities: About Persona Persona is the configurable identity platform built for businesses in a digital-first world.
Verifying individuals and organizations is harder — but more important — than ever, with AI enabling fraudsters to launch sophisticated accounts at scale and regulations evolving rapidly.
We’ve built Persona to support practically every use case and industry — that’s why we’re able to serve a wide range of leading companies.
For example, Reddit relies on Persona for age assurance and verification to comply with online safety regulations, protecting younger users while maintaining a seamless experience.
Meanwhile, OpenAI relies on Persona to keep bad actors out, protecting one of the world’s most powerful AI platforms from large-scale abuse in a time when AI is reshaping the way we work and live.
Cloudflare, ingress, DNS, and the service mesh are not background infrastructure.
They are the front door and backbone.
When they work, nobody notices.
requirements: We’re growing rapidly and looking for exceptional people to join us!
About the role & the team Every request Persona handles crosses our network before it touches any product code.
The Edge team exists because networking kept losing the prioritization battle inside a broader infrastructure team.
As we've grown, that became the wrong tradeoff, and we fixed it by giving networking its own home, its own roadmap, and its own definition of done.
You'll be one of the first engineers on a team with a clear, narrow mission and real ownership.
We are serious about encoding top-quality engineering practices into the team’s DNA — and you will be core to their development.

You should enjoy deep, methodical investigatory work — but also have the chops to quickly take on triage and solutioning should an emergency arise Kubernetes networking in practice: ingress controllers, DNS, network policies, not just running workloads Manages infrastructure as code in practice, not just in principle.

Change safety and governance should be a feature not a bug — and you enjoy designing those processes so they appear low-friction while having real teeth Experience building internal platforms or tools with a track record of driving adoption across engineering teams.
benefits: For full-time UK employees, Persona offers a wide range of benefits, including private medical insurance, dental insurance, a 6% employer pension contribution, unlimited PTO, a monthly wellness stipend, professional development stipend, co-working stipend, and more.
